candidate_claim_cn: 攻击者通过合法动作产生高惊奇但真实的转移，使优先经验回放垄断更新，从而压制受害任务的纠正数据并延迟恢复。

review.distinct_mechanism: transition prediction error exploited through prioritized experience replay
review.native_carrier: surprise-driven prioritized replay coupled to online transition regression
review.reason: This is standard prioritized-replay bias, replay starvation, and catastrophic forgetting, explicitly excluded from the desired world-model-specific mechanism.

proposed_defense: Task-stratified replay quotas, priority clipping, and GEM-style gradient projection
decision: Do not implement or run. No native carrier in the pinned backbones justifies spending experiment budget on this generic mechanism.
